question: The guiding motto of Nepal's foreign policy is what?
question_ne: नेपालको परराष्ट्र नीतिको मार्गदर्शक आदर्श वाक्य के हो?
options: Friendship with all, enmity with none
explanation: Nepal follows 'friendship with all, enmity with none' as the motto of its foreign policy.
explanation_ne: नेपालले 'सबैसँग मित्रता, कसैसँग शत्रुता छैन' लाई आफ्नो परराष्ट्र नीतिको आदर्श वाक्यका रूपमा पालना गर्छ।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus — foreign policy, diplomacy & international relations

question: Nepal's foreign policy is based on which principles?
question_ne: नेपालको परराष्ट्र नीति कुन सिद्धान्तमा आधारित छ?
explanation: Nepal's foreign policy is based on Panchsheel: mutual respect, non-aggression, non-interference, equality and peaceful coexistence.
explanation_ne: नेपालको परराष्ट्र नीति पञ्चशीलमा आधारित छ: पारस्परिक सम्मान, अनाक्रमण, अहस्तक्षेप, समानता र शान्तिपूर्ण सहअस्तित्व।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus — foreign policy, diplomacy & international relations

question: Which ministry handles Nepal's foreign affairs?
question_ne: नेपालको परराष्ट्र मामिला कुन मन्त्रालयले हेर्छ?
explanation: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MoFA) handles Nepal's foreign relations and diplomacy.
explanation_ne: परराष्ट्र मन्त्रालयले नेपालको परराष्ट्र सम्बन्ध र कूटनीति हेर्छ।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus — foreign policy, diplomacy & international relations

question: Where is Nepal's Ministry of Foreign Affairs located?
question_ne: नेपालको परराष्ट्र मन्त्रालय कहाँ छ?

question: Nepal established diplomatic relations with India in which year?

question: Nepal established diplomatic relations with China in which year?

explanation: Nepal established diplomatic relations with China on 1 August 1955.

source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus — foreign policy, diplomacy & international relations

question: Nepal established diplomatic relations with the United States in which year?

explanation: Nepal established diplomatic relations with the United States in 1947.
explanation_ne: नेपालले सन् १९४७ मा संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिकासँग कूटनीतिक सम्बन्ध स्थापना गर्‍यो।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus — foreign policy, diplomacy & international relations

question: Nepal established diplomatic relations with the United Kingdom in which year?

explanation: Nepal–UK diplomatic relations date to the Treaty of Sugauli in 1816, the oldest such relationship for Nepal.

question: How many countries does Nepal have diplomatic relations with as of 2026?

explanation: Nepal has diplomatic relations with more than 180 countries.

question: Which five countries are permanent members of the UN Security Council?
question_ne: संयुक्त राष्ट्रसंघ सुरक्षा परिषद्का पाँच स्थायी सदस्य कुन हुन्?
explanation: The five permanent members are China, France, Russia, the United Kingdom and the United States.

question: Nepal became a member of the WTO in which year?
question_ne: नेपाल WTO को सदस्य कुन वर्ष बन्यो?

question: BIMSTEC stands for what?

question: The Non-Aligned Movement (NAM) was founded in which year?

question: Nepal is a founding member of which movement?
question_ne: नेपाल कुन आन्दोलनको संस्थापक सदस्य हो?

question: The Bandung Conference, which led to NAM, was held in which year?
question_ne: NAM को आधार बनेको बान्डुङ सम्मेलन कुन वर्ष भयो?

question: The head of a Nepali embassy abroad is called what?
question_ne: विदेशमा रहेको नेपाली दूतावासका प्रमुखलाई के भनिन्छ?
explanation: The head of an embassy is an ambassador; Nepal's missions in Commonwealth countries are headed by high commissioners.
explanation_ne: दूतावासका प्रमुख राजदूत हुन्; राष्ट्रमण्डल देशमा नेपालका मिसन प्रमुख उच्चायुक्त हुन्छन्।

question: A diplomatic mission in a Commonwealth country is called what?

explanation: In Commonwealth countries, a diplomatic mission is called a High Commission, headed by a High Commissioner.

question: An ambassador presents credentials to whom in the host country?

explanation: An ambassador presents credentials to the head of state of the host country.
explanation_ne: राजदूतले आतिथ्य देशका राष्ट्राध्यक्षलाई ओहोदाको प्रमाणपत्र प्रस्तुत गर्छ।

question: Diplomatic immunity means what?
question_ne: कूटनीतिक उन्मुक्ति भनेको के हो?
options: Diplomats are exempt from the host country's criminal jurisdiction
Diplomats pay no taxes at home
Diplomats are above their own country's law
options_ne: कूटनीतिक अधिकारी आतिथ्य देशको फौजदारी क्षेत्राधिकारबाट मुक्त हुन्छन्
कूटनीतिक अधिकारी आफ्नै देशको कानुनभन्दा माथि हुन्छन्
explanation: Diplomatic immunity exempts diplomats from the host country's criminal jurisdiction, under the Vienna Convention, 1961.
explanation_ne: कूटनीतिक उन्मुक्तिले भियना महासन्धि, १९६१ अन्तर्गत कूटनीतिक अधिकारीलाई आतिथ्य देशको फौजदारी क्षेत्राधिकारबाट मुक्त गर्छ।

question: A person declared 'persona non grata' by a host country must do what?

explanation: A diplomat declared persona non grata must leave the host country.

question: The Nepal–India open border is governed by which treaty?

source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus — foreign policy, diplomacy & international relations

question: The Mahakali Treaty between Nepal and India was signed in which year?

question: The Pancheshwar Multipurpose Project is on which river?

question: Nepal's first treaty with Tibet/China, the Treaty of Thapathali, was signed in which year?

explanation: The Treaty of Thapathali was signed in 1856, ending the Nepal–Tibet war.

question: The Transit Treaty between Nepal and China was signed in which year?

explanation: The Nepal–China Transit Transport Agreement was signed in 2016, giving Nepal access to Chinese ports.

question: Which Chinese port did Nepal gain access to under the 2016 transit agreement?

explanation: The 2016 agreement gave Nepal access to Chinese ports including Tianjin, Shenzhen, Lianyungang and Zhanjiang.

question: Nepal's foreign policy gives priority to relations with which two neighbours?

question: The 'Look East' / neighbourhood-first approach in Nepal's foreign policy emphasises what?

question: Remittances contribute about what share of Nepal's GDP?

question: Which sector employs the most Nepali migrant workers abroad?

options: Construction and services in the Gulf and Malaysia

question: The Foreign Employment Act of Nepal was enacted in which year (BS)?

question: Which department issues labour permits for foreign employment in Nepal?

question: The Gurkha soldiers serve in the armies of which two countries?

question: Nepal's embassy in India is located in which city?

explanation: Nepal's embassy in India is in New Delhi.
explanation_ne: भारतमा नेपालको दूतावास नयाँ दिल्लीमा छ।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus — foreign policy, diplomacy & international relations

question: Nepal's embassy in China is located in which city?
question_ne: चीनमा नेपालको दूतावास कुन सहरमा छ?
explanation: Nepal's embassy in China is in Beijing.
explanation_ne: चीनमा नेपालको दूतावास बेइजिङमा छ।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus — foreign policy, diplomacy & international relations

question: Nepal's Permanent Mission to the UN is located in which city?
question_ne: संयुक्त राष्ट्रसंघका लागि नेपालको स्थायी मिसन कुन सहरमा छ?
explanation: Nepal's Permanent Mission to the UN is in New York; Nepal also has a mission in Geneva.
explanation_ne: संयुक्त राष्ट्रसंघका लागि नेपालको स्थायी मिसन न्युयोर्कमा छ; नेपालको जेनेभामा पनि मिसन छ।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus — foreign policy, diplomacy & international relations

question: Which country was the first to recognise Nepal as an independent state?
question_ne: नेपाललाई स्वतन्त्र राज्यका रूपमा मान्यता दिने पहिलो देश कुन हो?
options: United Kingdom (through the Treaty of Sugauli, 1816)
explanation: The UK recognised Nepal through the Treaty of Sugauli in 1816, the earliest such recognition.
explanation_ne: बेलायतले सुगौली सन्धि सन् १८१६ मार्फत नेपाललाई मान्यता दियो, सबैभन्दा पुरानो यस्तो मान्यता।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus — foreign policy, diplomacy & international relations

question: The Treaty of Sugauli defined Nepal's border mainly with which country?
question_ne: सुगौली सन्धिले नेपालको सीमा मुख्यतया कुन देशसँग परिभाषित गर्‍यो?
explanation: The Treaty of Sugauli (1816) defined Nepal's southern and western borders with British India.
explanation_ne: सुगौली सन्धि (१८१६) ले नेपालको दक्षिणी र पश्चिमी सीमा ब्रिटिस भारतसँग परिभाषित गर्‍यो।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus — foreign policy, diplomacy & international relations

question: The Kalapani–Lipulekh area is a border dispute between Nepal and which country?
question_ne: कालापानी–लिपुलेक क्षेत्र नेपाल र कुन देशबीचको सीमा विवाद हो?
explanation: Kalapani–Lipulekh is a border dispute between Nepal and India; Nepal published a revised map in 2020 including the area.
explanation_ne: कालापानी–लिपुलेक नेपाल र भारतबीचको सीमा विवाद हो; नेपालले सन् २०२० मा उक्त क्षेत्रसहित संशोधित नक्सा प्रकाशित गर्‍यो।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus — foreign policy, diplomacy & international relations

question: Nepal published a revised political map including Kalapani, Lipulekh and Limpiyadhura in which year?
question_ne: नेपालले कालापानी, लिपुलेक र लिम्पियाधुरा समेटेर संशोधित राजनीतिक नक्सा कुन वर्ष प्रकाशित गर्‍यो?
explanation: Nepal published a revised political map in May 2020 including Kalapani, Lipulekh and Limpiyadhura.
explanation_ne: नेपालले मे २०२० मा कालापानी, लिपुलेक र लिम्पियाधुरा समेटेर संशोधित राजनीतिक नक्सा प्रकाशित गर्‍यो।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus — foreign policy, diplomacy & international relations

question: The Constitution was amended for the second time in 2020 mainly to do what?
question_ne: संविधान सन् २०२० मा दोस्रो पटक संशोधन मुख्यतया के गर्न गरियो?
options: Update Nepal's political map in the Constitution
options_ne: संविधानमा नेपालको राजनीतिक नक्सा अद्यावधिक गर्न
explanation: The second amendment (18 June 2020) updated Nepal's political map in the Constitution to include Kalapani, Lipulekh and Limpiyadhura.
explanation_ne: दोस्रो संशोधन (१८ जुन २०२०) ले कालापानी, लिपुलेक र लिम्पियाधुरा समेट्न संविधानमा नेपालको राजनीतिक नक्सा अद्यावधिक गर्‍यो।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus — foreign policy, diplomacy & international relations

question: Which river forms a large part of the Nepal–India border in the east?
question_ne: पूर्वमा नेपाल–भारत सीमाको ठूलो भाग कुन नदीले बनाउँछ?
explanation: The Mechi River forms the eastern Nepal–India border; the Mahakali forms the western border.
explanation_ne: मेची नदीले पूर्वी नेपाल–भारत सीमा बनाउँछ; महाकालीले पश्चिमी सीमा बनाउँछ।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus — foreign policy, diplomacy & international relations

question: Nepal shares a border with how many Indian states?
question_ne: नेपालले कति भारतीय राज्यसँग सीमा साझा गर्छ?
explanation: Nepal borders five Indian states: Uttarakhand, Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, West Bengal and Sikkim.
explanation_ne: नेपालले पाँच भारतीय राज्यसँग सीमा साझा गर्छ: उत्तराखण्ड, उत्तर प्रदेश, बिहार, पश्चिम बंगाल र सिक्किम।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus — foreign policy, diplomacy & international relations

question: Nepal shares a border with which Chinese autonomous region?
question_ne: नेपालले चीनको कुन स्वायत्त क्षेत्रसँग सीमा साझा गर्छ?
explanation: Nepal borders the Tibet Autonomous Region of China along its northern frontier.
explanation_ne: नेपालले उत्तरी सीमामा चीनको तिब्बत स्वायत्त क्षेत्रसँग सीमा साझा गर्छ।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus — foreign policy, diplomacy & international relations

question: Which pass connects Nepal with Tibet/China at the Rasuwagadhi crossing?
question_ne: रसुवागढी नाकामा नेपाललाई तिब्बत/चीनसँग जोड्ने पास कुन हो?
explanation: Rasuwagadhi–Kerung is a major Nepal–China border crossing in Rasuwa district.
explanation_ne: रसुवागढी–केरुङ रसुवा जिल्लामा नेपाल–चीनको प्रमुख सीमा नाका हो।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus — foreign policy, diplomacy & international relations

question: The Kodari–Zhangmu border crossing connects Nepal with China in which district?
question_ne: कोदारी–झाङ्मु सीमा नाकाले नेपाललाई चीनसँग कुन जिल्लामा जोड्छ?
explanation: The Kodari–Zhangmu (Tatopani) crossing is in Sindhupalchok district.
explanation_ne: कोदारी–झाङ्मु (तातोपानी) नाका सिन्धुपाल्चोक जिल्लामा छ।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus — foreign policy, diplomacy & international relations

question: Which Nepali port does Nepal use for third-country trade through India?
question_ne: नेपालले भारत हुँदै तेस्रो देशसँग व्यापार गर्न कुन बन्दरगाह प्रयोग गर्छ?
explanation: Nepal uses Kolkata port in India for most third-country trade, under the Nepal–India transit treaty.
explanation_ne: नेपालले नेपाल–भारत पारवहन सन्धिअन्तर्गत धेरैजसो तेस्रो देश व्यापारका लागि भारतको कोलकाता बन्दरगाह प्रयोग गर्छ।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus — foreign policy, diplomacy & international relations

question: The Nepal–India Transit Treaty was first signed in which year?
question_ne: नेपाल–भारत पारवहन सन्धि पहिलो पटक कुन वर्ष हस्ताक्षर भयो?
explanation: The Nepal–India Transit Treaty was first signed in 1960 and has been renewed since.
explanation_ne: नेपाल–भारत पारवहन सन्धि पहिलो पटक सन् १९६० मा हस्ताक्षर भयो र त्यसपछि नवीकरण हुँदै आएको छ।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus — foreign policy, diplomacy & international relations

question: The World Bank's country office in Nepal is located in which city?
question_ne: विश्व बैंकको नेपालस्थित देश कार्यालय कुन सहरमा छ?
explanation: The World Bank's country office in Nepal is in Kathmandu.
explanation_ne: विश्व बैंकको नेपालस्थित देश कार्यालय काठमाडौंमा छ।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus — foreign policy, diplomacy & international relations

question: Foreign aid to Nepal is coordinated mainly by which ministry?
question_ne: नेपालमा विदेशी सहायता मुख्यतया कुन मन्त्रालयले समन्वय गर्छ?
explanation: Foreign aid is coordinated mainly by the Ministry of Finance, with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs handling diplomatic aspects.
explanation_ne: विदेशी सहायता मुख्यतया अर्थ मन्त्रालयले समन्वय गर्छ, परराष्ट्र मन्त्रालयले कूटनीतिक पक्ष हेर्छ।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus — foreign policy, diplomacy & international relations

question: The Aid Management Information System (AMIS) in Nepal is maintained by which ministry?
question_ne: नेपालमा सहायता व्यवस्थापन सूचना प्रणाली (AMIS) कुन मन्त्रालयले राख्छ?
explanation: AMIS is maintained by the Ministry of Finance to track foreign aid in Nepal.
explanation_ne: AMIS नेपालमा विदेशी सहायता ट्र्याक गर्न अर्थ मन्त्रालयले राख्छ।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus — foreign policy, diplomacy & international relations

question: Which body formulates Nepal's five-year development plans?
question_ne: नेपालको पञ्चवर्षीय विकास योजना कुन निकायले बनाउँछ?
explanation: The National Planning Commission formulates Nepal's periodic development plans.
explanation_ne: राष्ट्रिय योजना आयोगले नेपालको आवधिक विकास योजना बनाउँछ।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus — foreign policy, diplomacy & international relations

question: Nepal's per capita income is approximately how much (USD, 2024/25)?
question_ne: नेपालको प्रतिव्यक्ति आय लगभग कति छ (अमेरिकी डलर, २०२४/२५)?
explanation: Nepal's per capita income is about 1,400 USD (around 1,381 USD in FY 2023/24).
explanation_ne: नेपालको प्रतिव्यक्ति आय करिब १,४०० अमेरिकी डलर छ (आर्थिक वर्ष २०२३/२४ मा करिब १,३८१ अमेरिकी डलर)।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus — foreign policy, diplomacy & international relations

question: Nepal's main export to India is what?
question_ne: भारतमा नेपालको मुख्य निर्यात के हो?
options: Palm oil, soybean oil and other edible oils (recent years)
options_ne: पाम तेल, भटमास तेल र अन्य खाद्य तेल (हालका वर्ष)
explanation: In recent years, refined edible oils (palm and soybean oil) have been Nepal's main exports to India.
explanation_ne: हालका वर्षमा परिष्कृत खाद्य तेल (पाम र भटमास तेल) भारतमा नेपालको मुख्य निर्यात भएको छ।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus — foreign policy, diplomacy & international relations

question: Nepal's main import from India is what?
question_ne: भारतबाट नेपालको मुख्य आयात के हो?
explanation: Petroleum products are Nepal's largest import from India.
explanation_ne: पेट्रोलियम पदार्थ भारतबाट नेपालको सबैभन्दा ठूलो आयात हो।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus — foreign policy, diplomacy & international relations

question: The Nepal Oil Corporation imports petroleum mainly from which country?
question_ne: नेपाल आयल निगमले पेट्रोलियम मुख्यतया कुन देशबाट आयात गर्छ?
explanation: Nepal Oil Corporation imports petroleum products mainly from the Indian Oil Corporation under a government-to-government arrangement.
explanation_ne: नेपाल आयल निगमले सरकार-सरकार व्यवस्थाअन्तर्गत मुख्यतया इन्डियन आयल कर्पोरेसनबाट पेट्रोलियम पदार्थ आयात गर्छ।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus — foreign policy, diplomacy & international relations

question: Which is Nepal's largest source of foreign exchange earnings?
question_ne: नेपालको विदेशी मुद्रा आर्जनको सबैभन्दा ठूलो स्रोत कुन हो?
explanation: Remittances are Nepal's largest source of foreign exchange earnings, ahead of tourism and exports.
explanation_ne: विप्रेषण नेपालको विदेशी मुद्रा आर्जनको सबैभन्दा ठूलो स्रोत हो, पर्यटन र निर्यातभन्दा अगाडि।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus — foreign policy, diplomacy & international relations

question: Tourism contributes about what share of Nepal's GDP?
question_ne: पर्यटनले नेपालको GDP मा करिब कति हिस्सा योगदान गर्छ?
explanation: Tourism contributes roughly 6–7% of Nepal's GDP including indirect effects; direct contribution is smaller.
explanation_ne: पर्यटनले अप्रत्यक्ष प्रभावसहित नेपालको GDP मा करिब ६–७% योगदान गर्छ; प्रत्यक्ष योगदान सानो छ।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus — foreign policy, diplomacy & international relations

question: Which is Nepal's most visited tourist destination?
question_ne: नेपालको सबैभन्दा धेरै भ्रमण गरिने पर्यटकीय गन्तव्य कुन हो?
explanation: Kathmandu Valley, with its UNESCO sites, is Nepal's most visited destination; Pokhara and Chitwan follow.
explanation_ne: युनेस्को स्थलसहित काठमाडौं उपत्यका नेपालको सबैभन्दा धेरै भ्रमण गरिने गन्तव्य हो; त्यसपछि पोखरा र चितवन पर्छन्।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus — foreign policy, diplomacy & international relations

question: The Buddha was born in Lumbini in approximately which year BCE?
question_ne: बुद्ध लुम्बिनीमा लगभग कुन वर्ष ईसापूर्व जन्मिए?
explanation: The Buddha is traditionally dated to 623 BCE (Lumbini Development Trust) or 563 BCE (common scholarly dating); the 623 BCE date is used in Nepal.
explanation_ne: बुद्धको जन्म परम्परागत रूपमा ६२३ ईसापूर्व (लुम्बिनी विकास कोष) वा ५६३ ईसापूर्व (सामान्य विद्वान् मिति) मानिन्छ; नेपालमा ६२३ ईसापूर्व प्रयोग हुन्छ।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus — foreign policy, diplomacy & international relations

question: The first person to climb Mount Everest was whom, and in which year?
question_ne: सगरमाथा चढ्ने पहिलो व्यक्ति को थिए र कुन वर्ष?
options_ne: एडमन्ड हिलारी र तेन्जिङ नोर्गे, सन् १९५३
explanation: Edmund Hillary of New Zealand and Tenzing Norgay of Nepal first climbed Everest on 29 May 1953.
explanation_ne: न्युजिल्यान्डका एडमन्ड हिलारी र नेपालका तेन्जिङ नोर्गेले २९ मे १९५३ मा पहिलो पटक सगरमाथा चढे।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus — foreign policy, diplomacy & international relations

question: The first woman to climb Mount Everest was whom?
question_ne: सगरमाथा चढ्ने पहिलो महिला को थिइन्?
explanation: Junko Tabei of Japan was the first woman to climb Everest, on 16 May 1975.
explanation_ne: जापानकी जुन्को ताबेई सगरमाथा चढ्ने पहिलो महिला थिइन्, १६ मे १९७५ मा।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus — foreign policy, diplomacy & international relations

question: Pasang Lhamu Sherpa was the first Nepali woman to climb Everest, in which year?
question_ne: पासाङ ल्हामु शेर्पा सगरमाथा चढ्ने पहिलो नेपाली महिला थिइन्, कुन वर्ष?
explanation: Pasang Lhamu Sherpa became the first Nepali woman to climb Everest in 1993; she died during the descent.
explanation_ne: पासाङ ल्हामु शेर्पा सन् १९९३ मा सगरमाथा चढ्ने पहिलो नेपाली महिला भइन्; उनी झर्ने क्रममा निधन भइन्।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus — foreign policy, diplomacy & international relations

question: Nepal's national anthem is titled what?
question_ne: नेपालको राष्ट्रिय गानको शीर्षक के हो?
explanation: Nepal's national anthem is 'Sayaun Thunga Phulka' (Made of Hundreds of Flowers), written by Pradeep Kumar Rai (Byakul Maila).
explanation_ne: नेपालको राष्ट्रिय गान 'सयौँ थुँगा फूलका' हो, प्रदीपकुमार राई (व्याकुल माइला) ले लेखेका हुन्।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus — foreign policy, diplomacy & international relations

question: The two triangles of Nepal's flag represent what?
question_ne: नेपालको झण्डाका दुई त्रिभुजले के प्रतिनिधित्व गर्छन्?
options: The Himalayas and Hinduism/Buddhism (also the two major religions)
The sun and the moon only
options_ne: हिमालय र हिन्दु/बौद्ध धर्म (दुई प्रमुख धर्म)
explanation: The two triangles represent the Himalayas and the two major religions, Hinduism and Buddhism; the sun and moon on them symbolise permanence.
explanation_ne: दुई त्रिभुजले हिमालय र दुई प्रमुख धर्म, हिन्दु र बौद्ध धर्म प्रतिनिधित्व गर्छन्; तिनमा रहेको सूर्य र चन्द्रमाले स्थायित्व जनाउँछन्।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus — foreign policy, diplomacy & international relations

question: The International Day of Peace is observed on which date?
question_ne: अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय शान्ति दिवस कुन मितिमा मनाइन्छ?
explanation: The International Day of Peace is observed on 21 September each year.
explanation_ne: अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय शान्ति दिवस हरेक वर्ष २१ सेप्टेम्बरमा मनाइन्छ।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus — foreign policy, diplomacy & international relations

question: Human Rights Day is observed on which date?
question_ne: मानव अधिकार दिवस कुन मितिमा मनाइन्छ?
explanation: Human Rights Day is observed on 10 December, the anniversary of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights (1948).
explanation_ne: मानव अधिकार दिवस १० डिसेम्बरमा मनाइन्छ, मानव अधिकारको विश्वव्यापी घोषणापत्र (१९४८) को वार्षिकोत्सव।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus — foreign policy, diplomacy & international relations

question: The World Bank was established in which year?
question_ne: विश्व बैंक कुन वर्ष स्थापना भयो?
explanation: The World Bank was established in 1944 at the Bretton Woods Conference.
explanation_ne: विश्व बैंक सन् १९४४ मा ब्रेटन वुड्स सम्मेलनमा स्थापना भयो।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus — foreign policy, diplomacy & international relations

question: The IMF was established in which year?
question_ne: IMF कुन वर्ष स्थापना भयो?
explanation: The IMF was established in 1944 at the Bretton Woods Conference and began operations in 1947.

question: The country code for Nepal in international dialling is what?

question: Which satellite does Nepal use for its own communications satellite service?

question: NepalSat-1 was launched in which year?

question: Which organisation regulates the use of radio frequencies in Nepal?
question_ne: नेपालमा रेडियो फ्रिक्वेन्सी प्रयोग नियमन गर्ने निकाय कुन हो?

question: The Rural Telecommunications Development Fund in Nepal is managed by whom?

question: What percentage levy on telecom operators funds the Rural Telecommunications Development Fund?

question: Nepal Telecom's Level 4 Assistant preliminary examination has how many MCQs?

question: Nepal Telecom examinations are conducted by which body?

question: Which of the following is a competitor of Nepal Telecom in mobile services?

question: WorldLink is best known in Nepal as what?

question: A router's main function is to do what?

question: Which cable is used for high-speed fibre internet?

question: Which cable is commonly used for Ethernet LAN connections?

question: The 5 GHz Wi-Fi band is best known for what?

question: Which of the following is a mobile generation that came before 4G?

question: What is the maximum length of a standard single SMS?
